description: Image Description: The image shows a collection of five snowboards standing upright against a wall. Each snowboard has a different design and color scheme. From left to right, the first snowboard features a cityscape graphic with green bindings. The second snowboard is predominantly black with red accents and has a "Nitro" logo. The third snowboard is light green with a floral pattern and white bindings. The fourth snowboard is red with a graphic of a woman's face and has black bindings. The fifth snowboard is gray-green
